_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for materials, vehicles and planning numbers. Edit here; no code changes needed. Commit to GitHub and Render redeploys. To refresh the demo data to this taxonomy, set env var FORCE_RESEED=1 for one deploy, then remove it.
_materials_note: Broad, enterprise-generic categories any large-construction project recognises. Each carries a planning density (loose, as-hauled t/m3), a default input unit, whether volume<->weight conversion is meaningful, and the vehicles typically used. Densities vary with moisture/compaction; treat as editable defaults.

_vehicles_note: EU N-category road HGVs over 3.5t (no site plant). payload_t = typical carrying limit; emissions from UK DEFRA/BEIS 2025 basis (kg CO2e per vehicle-km, average laden). load_minutes/unload_minutes are per-vehicle turnaround estimates and override planning.load_minutes/unload_minutes, which remain the fallback. They are starting estimates, not measured — edit to match your operation.

N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle TPMLM 32 t tipper._payload_basis: 18 t is the conservative planning payload given in the 2026-09-01 build list. The pre-existing 'Rigid 8-wheeler (32t)' entry is the same chassis class and carries 20 t. Both are in this file on purpose; neither was changed.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle TPMLM 32 t tipper._emissions_basis: NOT given in the build list. Copied from 'Rigid 8-wheeler (32t)' - same EU category, axle count and GVW, and the DEFRA/BEIS 2025 basis the rest of this file uses. Replace with a measured figure if you have one.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle TPMLM 32 t tipper._aliases_note: '8x4 tipper' is the trade name given in the build list. Nothing reads `aliases` yet - it is stored so the roster's own wording survives.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle TPMLM 32 t tipper._routing_note: height_cm / width_cm / length_cm are ABSENT because the build list does not give them. here_routing._truck_params() sends only the keys present, so HERE routes this on weight and axle count alone - it does not borrow another vehicle's dimensions.

N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle mixer 32 t._payload_basis: THE BUILD LIST GIVES 8 m3, NOT A TONNAGE. payload_m3 holds that figure verbatim. payload_t = 8 m3 x 2.4 t/m3, the 'Precast / concrete' density already in this file - DERIVED, not sourced. It is very likely too high as a MASS payload: 19.2 t of concrete plus the drum exceeds what a 32 t GVW 4-axle can legally carry. conversions.py reads payload_t only, so a forecast entered in 'vehicles' on this profile converts on 19.2. Correct it the moment the roster gives a mass figure. Recorded in claude/open-questions.md.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle mixer 32 t._emissions_basis: NOT given in the build list. Copied from 'Rigid 8-wheeler (32t)' - same EU category, axle count and GVW, DEFRA/BEIS 2025 basis.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle mixer 32 t._aliases_note: '8x4 mixer' is a restatement of '4-axle mixer', not a trade name taken from the roster. Correct it if the roster words it differently.
N3 lorry (BA) 4-axle mixer 32 t._routing_note: Dimensions absent - not given. See the V07 note.

N3 tractor (BC) + O4 semi (DA) GCW 40 t._payload_basis: 25.5 t is the conservative planning payload given in the 2026-09-01 build list. gvw_t 40 is the GCW it quotes, so tare works out at 14.5 t - which here_routing.tare_weight_kg() uses for the unladen return leg.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 semi (DA) GCW 40 t._emissions_basis: NOT given in the build list. Copied from the two 44 t artic entries in this file, DEFRA/BEIS 2025 basis. A 40 t combination is lighter than a 44 t one, so this is if anything slightly high.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 semi (DA) GCW 40 t._aliases_note: Restatements of the EU description, NOT trade names taken from the roster. Correct if the roster words them differently.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 semi (DA) GCW 40 t._routing_note: axle_count is ABSENT as well as the dimensions: the build list says 'tractor (BC) + semi (DA)' with no axle count, and a 40 t combination is 5 or 6 axles depending on configuration. Guessing it would change which roads HERE allows.

N3 tractor (BC) + O4 tipping semi (DA) G._payload_basis: 26 t is the conservative planning payload given in the 2026-09-01 build list. The list quotes '40/44 t'; gvw_t is stored as 40 because that is the base GCW and 44 t applies only in specific combined-transport configurations. Tare therefore works out at 14 t. If 44 t is right for your operation, change gvw_t AND routing.gross_weight_kg together - they are read by different code paths.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 tipping semi (DA) G._emissions_basis: NOT given in the build list. Copied from the two 44 t artic entries in this file, DEFRA/BEIS 2025 basis.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 tipping semi (DA) G._aliases_note: Restatements of the EU description, NOT trade names from the roster. Note 'artic tipper' is only an ALIAS - it is not the pre-existing 'Artic Tipper (44t)' key, which is a different entry with a 29 t payload.
N3 tractor (BC) + O4 tipping semi (DA) G._routing_note: axle_count and dimensions absent - not given. See the V11 note.

_planning_vehicles_note: The four EU-named entries above carry planning_vehicle: true and are listed FIRST in every picker. The six pre-existing entries are kept, unchanged, and listed after them as legacy. That is deliberate: every baked route_geometry row is keyed on vehicle_profile, network.DEFAULT_PROFILE is 'Artic Tipper (44t)', and every material category's `vehicles` list names them - remove one and its routes' payload, CO2 and trips/day fall through to _default (20 t, 0.90 kg/km) and every affected route then reports identical figures. Decided 2026-09-01: add four, keep six. None of the four carries load_minutes / unload_minutes, so all four fall back to planning.load_minutes 12 + planning.unload_minutes 8 = a 20-minute turnaround, which is stated rather than invented.

_planning_note: Used to estimate haul-cycle turnaround, trips/day and fleet size. load_minutes and unload_minutes here are the fallback only; a vehicle's own values take precedence.
_seasonal_note: Calendar months (1=Jan..12=Dec) with statutory HGV weight/access restrictions in Estonia. Shown as a warning at submission when a forecast month falls in a window (and, if listed, the chosen vehicle is heavier-restricted). Editable.

seasonal_restrictions.name: Spring thaw
seasonal_restrictions.message: Spring thaw: axle-weight limits likely on secondary roads — heavy artics may be restricted. Consider a lighter vehicle or a different month.

seasonal_restrictions.name: Winter
seasonal_restrictions.message: Winter conditions: check road access and allow longer cycle times on this corridor.

_routing_note: vehicles[].routing holds HGV dimensions for HERE truck routing (weight kg, sizes cm, axle count).
_materials_vehicles_note: Which of the four new planning vehicles each category lists is CLAUDE'S INFERENCE, 2026-09-01, not sourced from the build list: V07/V12 tippers on soil and aggregates, V10 mixer on concrete, V11 flat semi on concrete/steel/general. It had to be decided because the Submit Forecast picker DISABLES a vehicle a category does not list, so an unlisted planning vehicle would be unselectable. The join is advisory in the UI, not enforced - correct any line of it freely.
